items.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] One of them was from near us, from Syracuse I believe, Nick Frenay I think his name was, a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Yes. And I’m so pleased with what it has done. It has really given these young people who have been fellows there really a start that we just wish that all students that are really talented could have. Because it gives them, right out of high school, one or two years in a protected environment where they just concentrate on being good musicians. And in the process of doing that there are a lot of performances. And in these performances some of them are outreaches where they go into the schools and capture the…

One of them was from near us, from Syracuse I believe, Nick Frenay I think his name was, a trumpet player. That’s really neat, because it’s like almost the way young jazz musicians learned to operate in the world. They would be playing at a young age with mentors.
